social_media.headline: Active Space Weather Week Expected
social_media.summary: Elevated solar activity is expected this week, with multiple opportunities for strong flares and possible Earth-directed CMEs.

confidence.label: Confidence
confidence.detail: An increase in activity is likely this week, but the timing and impacts of any Earth-directed CME remain uncertain.

what_we_know: Several active regions are producing flares.
Strong flares are likely, and major flares remain possible.
Impacts are possible, but timing and severity are not yet certain.

footer.left: SWPC will continue to monitor the situation and issue updates as needed.
footer.center: Outlooks are issued once weekly on Mondays.
